title: Longest Strictly Increasing Segment
description:
Given an array of n integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing contiguous segment.

A segment is strictly increasing if each element is greater than the previous one.
inputFormat:
First line: integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5)
Second line: n integers a[i] (-10^9 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^9)
outputFormat: Single integer: length of the longest strictly increasing segment

title: Maximum Subarray Sum With One Deletion
description:
Given an array of integers, find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray after deleting at most one element.

You can choose to delete one element or keep all elements.
inputFormat:
First line: integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5)
Second line: n integers a[i] (-10^4 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^4)
outputFormat: Single integer: maximum subarray sum after at most one deletion

title: Smallest String After One Swap
description:
Given a string consisting of lowercase letters, you can swap exactly one pair of characters (at different positions). Return the lexicographically smallest string possible after exactly one swap.

If the string is already the smallest possible, swap any two characters.
outputFormat: Single line: lexicographically smallest string after exactly one swap

title: Longest Balanced Parentheses Substring
description:
Given a string containing only '(' and ')' characters, find the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.

A valid parentheses substring is one where every '(' has a matching ')' in the correct order.
outputFormat: Single integer: length of longest balanced parentheses substring

title: Minimum Flips to Make Binary String Alternating
description:
Given a binary string (containing only '0' and '1'), find the minimum number of flips required to make the string alternating.

An alternating string is one where no two adjacent characters are the same (e.g., '010101' or '101010').
outputFormat: Single integer: minimum number of flips needed
